newsitem.title: JAPAN: Australian Capital Territory launches yen/NZ$ dual.
newsitem.headline: Australian Capital Territory launches yen/NZ$ dual.

text.p: Australian Capital Territory launched 6.5 billion yen in 6.0 percent yen/New Zealand dollar dual-currency samurai bonds, Kokusai Securities, one of the joint lead managers, said on Thursday.
The bonds are priced at par, and the coupon payments will be made twice a year.
Holders of the samurai bonds will receive NZ$6,176.65 for each 500,000 yen bond at maturity.
The coupon will be paid in yen, while redemption will be in New Zealand dollars.
The breakdown of the terms is as follows.
AMT 6.5 bln yen COUPON 6.00 pct MATURITY Nov 29, 1999
TYPE yen/NZ$ samurai ISS PRICE 100.00 yen
JOINT LEAD MANAGERS Kokusai Securities, BT Asia Securities
